_doc: AC-2.1 anchor golden (design/adapters/openreview.md §7). Per-year {year, openreview_venueid|null, accepted_count, dblp_slug, dblp_toc_count, survey_approx_count, note}. STRUCTURE (year list + venueid case) is authoritative and asserted offline (tests/integration/test_openreview_acceptance.py). accepted_count (OpenReview venueid-filtered accepted count) is null = PENDING user token: [LIVE] 2026-07-22 the configured token was EXPIRED (401 TokenExpiredError — not a UA challenge, not a code defect; the cookie mechanism was server-validated correct), so the token-gated /notes sweep is BLOCKED pending a refreshed token. dblp_toc_count = [LIVE] 2026-07-22 count of `<li class="entry inproceedings">` on dblp.org/db/conf/iclr/iclr<year>.html (main-conference papers; the single `entry editor` = proceedings volume, excluded); populated for a representative subset (2013,2014,2015,2016,2024) — the remaining modern years' DBLP counts are deferred to the same session that unblocks the OpenReview accepted_count column (so both columns are captured together for the real cross-check). CORRECTION (supersedes prior draft + site-survey §9): DBLP DOES index iclr2015/iclr2016 (electronic edition @ iclr.cc, not openreview.net) — the survey's 'both sides missing 2015/2016' was falsified [LIVE]; OpenReview simply never hosted those two main conferences (2015 no conference group; 2016 only ICLR.cc/2016/workshop). survey_approx_count carries the site-survey §9 magnitude seed for reference ONLY. | [LIVE UPDATE 2026-07-22 AC-2.2 final] accepted_count populated from content.venueid=<group_id> note count (limit=1000; see live_verification). count_status LIVE_2026-07-22_HETEROGENEOUS: values are the adapter accepted-filter count on the serving endpoint, DBLP-cross-validated only at 2024 (2260). Anomalies (2018/2019=0 both APIs; 2022/2023 v1 inflated; 2013/2014=0 arXiv-era) recorded per-year.

live_verification.accepted_count_method: count from GET <endpoint>/notes?content.venueid=<group_id>&limit=1000 (the adapter's accepted-filter query). limit=1000 is REQUIRED: api2/v2 OMITS the `count` envelope field at limit=1 (empirically confirmed 2026-07-22) — it only returns `count` at limit=1000. Endpoint per served data: v2/api2 for 2024/2025/2026; v1/api.openreview.net for 2017/2020/2021/2022/2023; count==0 on BOTH APIs for 2013/2014/2018/2019.
live_verification.accepted_count_caveat: HETEROGENEOUS across editions — the content.venueid==group_id count is NOT uniformly 'accepted only'. VALIDATED == DBLP accepted ONLY at 2024 (2260==2260). v1-served 2022/2023 (2617/3792) exceed survey accepted (~1095/~1570) → include non-accepted submissions. 2018/2019 == 0 on BOTH APIs (accepted notes carry a non-group-id content.venueid; adapter accepted-filter would enumerate 0). 2013/2014 == 0 (arXiv-body era). This falsifies the 'one limit=1 request → clean accepted count per year' assumption; see acceptance report concerns.
live_verification.timeline_vs_live_venues: ±0 EXACT — `timeline iclr` years {2013,2014,2017-2027} == live OpenReview `groups?id=venues` ICLR main-conference groups (case-exact). Re-confirmed [LIVE] 2026-07-22 by tests/online AC-2.1 (PASSED).
live_verification.timeline_vs_dblp_index: NOT ±0 — DBLP-only {2015,2016} + OpenReview-only {2026,2027}. Explained scope differences, not adapter defects.
live_verification.dblp_count_method: count of `<li class="entry inproceedings">` on iclr<year>.html; 2024=2260 matches both survey_approx_count 2260 and the [LIVE] OpenReview accepted count 2260.
